cohort: 15,012 women from the Tohoku Medical Megabank Project Birth and Three-Generation Cohort Study
finding: Higher neuroticism and lower extraversion were associated with increased risk of postpartum depressive symptoms and all three symptom dimensions, while lower psychoticism was only associated with anxiety.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered as a confounding variable in the analysis of personality traits and postpartum depressive symptoms, but specific findings related to mode of delivery are not reported.
